text:
remy (design): Quick thread: noticed inline code and chart tooltip text wash out in dark console at smaller sizes. Prototype attached in Figma.

kai (frontend): Saw it. Which tokens are you thinking to update? The pale-cream inline code is the main offender.

remy (design): Plan: code bg -> #04161a, inline text -> #cfeef4, border -> #12393f. For charts swap the lime series to a warmer teal (#5ecdb6) so it keeps contrast on 1px strokes.

tara (product): Teal for that series sounds good. Also can we standardize the copy: use "P95 latency" everywhere and add unit hover for embeddings.

kai (frontend): Will need CSS vars. Small note: text-main at #cfeef4 passes but chips (11px) fail 4.5:1, aria-bot will flag.

remy (design): Good call. I'll nudge chip text to #c8e6eb. Also propose lavender -> #bdaaff to help with overlap against teal.

aria-bot: Accessibility check queued. Report in ~4m. :robot_face:

aria-bot: Report: flagged items -> chip contrast, lavender vs teal low contrast at 1px.

remy (design): Action items: chip -> #c2e0e6, lavender -> #b09dff. Also add optional hatch for alert fills when cell size <=8px.

kai (frontend): I'll implement vars and hatch toggle (prefers-contrast: more + user setting). Will add tiny 1px shadow behind lines for separation on overlap.

tara (product): Thanks — ship note blurb: "Dark theme: tightened chart colors, improved inline code legibility, P95 copy polish, and accessibility hatches for dense charts."

remy (design): I'll update the Figma and attach assets. Ping me when the accessibility run is green and I'll write the release blurb.

aria-bot: Re-run complete: all items resolved.
